instruction: Buy me a portable air conditioner on amazon from its highest-rated seller using my chase card for my home address.
notes: Single-app (amazon) purchase task. The seller with the highest rating among those selling portable air conditioners is modeled as the abstract object top-rated-seller with the static world fact (highest-rated-seller-for ...) in :init; the agent resolves it at runtime by calling amazon.search_products with product_type="portable air conditioner" (all pages) and amazon.show_seller for every distinct seller found, picking the max rating (the plan shows one representative show_seller step). add_product_to_cart requires the seller rating to have been looked up and the product to be sold by the highest-rated seller, and uses quantity 1. amazon.clear_cart is required before adding so the resulting order contains exactly one product with quantity 1. Address and card ids are discovered via show_addresses (name == Home) and show_payment_cards (card_name == Chase); no address is modified. supervisor.complete_task carries the order record parameters (not API arguments) so that its precondition equals the goal's ordered fact, and it is the only action that sets task-completed; all other actions require (not (task-completed)).
